verdict.rationale: Figma's official MCP server, local and remote, lets a coding agent turn selected frames into code. It also pulls variables, components and layout data into the IDE (e.g. get_variable_defs), and Code Connect supplies component-to-codebase mappings. However, no evidence shows screenshot retrieval, so one named element of the story is undocumented and coverage is partial. missing for 10: documented screenshot/image retrieval for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP-driven implementation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can pull real design context — frames, variables, screenshots, component mappings — through an MCP server or API to implement the design

citations.quote: Select a Figma frame and turn it into code.
Pull in variables, components, and layout data directly into your IDE.
`get_variable_defs` extracts the **variables and styles** used in your selection (color, spacing, typography, etc).
Code Connect keeps your generated code consistent with your codebase.
Figma's remote MCP server makes it possible to connect directly to your Figma files without needing to install Figma's desktop app.
